name: MuffinEMU
subtitle: Wii U emulation for iPhone and iPad.
description: The install source for MuffinEMU, a Wii U emulator for iPhone and iPad built on Cemu. This source serves the standard build for SideStore, AltStore and LiveContainer, which re-sign it with your own Apple ID at install.

apps.name: MuffinEMU
apps.subtitle: Wii U emulator for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
MuffinEMU is a Wii U emulator for iPhone and iPad, iOS 15 and later, built on Cemu: PowerPC interpreters, an AArch64 recompiler, Cafe OS HLE and a native Metal renderer under a SwiftUI app with a measured Wii U GamePad layout. Some MeloCafe cores and bug fixes have been brought over to MuffinEMU.

This source serves the standard build for SideStore, AltStore and LiveContainer, which re-sign it with your own Apple ID at install.

Bring your own games and keys. No copyrighted content is distributed here.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What changed

- Add files via upload

MuffinEMU, Wii U emulation for iPhone and iPad, built from commit 3d06374eae90eb11d2daf33a0382d8e4e92f2925.

**`MuffinEMU.ipa`** - SideStore / AltStore / LiveContainer. Unsigned; they re-sign
with your own Apple ID at install.

**`MuffinEMU-fakesigned.ipa`** - TrollStore or jailbroken only, with the JIT
entitlements embedded.

The recompiler needs a JIT enabler (StikJIT, SideStore, LiveContainer) and the
"Use the recompiler (JIT)" switch in Settings; without both it runs the
interpreter. `MuffinEMU.app.dSYM.zip` is only needed to symbolicate a crash report.

MuffinEMU is built on Cemu. Some MeloCafe cores and bug fixes have been brought over to MuffinEMU.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/hexabidecimal-star/Hexa-s-MuffinEMU-/compare/v1.7...v1.8
